# Permission matrix

The matrix below is `permissionMatrix` in `Backend/auth/rbac.ts`, rendered
as-is. The server checks it on every request; the web app receives the
caller's row from `GET /api/me/capabilities` and never keeps its own copy.
For what the areas, levels and scopes mean, read
[Roles and permissions](roles-and-permissions.md).

## Levels

Levels are ordered; a check for a level passes for that level and every level
above it (`can()` compares ranks).

| Rank | Level |
|---|---|
| 0 | `none` |
| 1 | `view` |
| 2 | `contribute` |
| 3 | `manage` |
| 4 | `admin` |

## Role × area

| Area | Owner | Project manager | Developer | Designer | Tester | Operations |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Organization** | `admin` | `view` | `view` | `view` | `view` | `view` |
| **Product** | `admin` | `manage` | `contribute` | `contribute` | `contribute` | `view` |
| **Project** | `admin` | `manage` | `contribute` | `contribute` | `contribute` | `view` |
| **Repository** | `admin` | `view` | `contribute` | `view` | `view` | `view` |
| **Deployment** | `admin` | `view` | `view` | `none` | `view` | `manage` |
| **Infrastructure** | `admin` | `none` | `view` | `none` | `none` | `manage` |
| **Administration** | `admin` | `none` | `none` | `none` | `none` | `view` |

Product scope applies on top of every cell: apart from the Owner, a member
only sees rows belonging to the products they are assigned to, and anything
outside that scope answers `404`.

not listed here authenticates the caller but has no area guard; it is still

### Step-up without an area guard

Routes that require a fresh strong verification (`requireStepUp`) but no
`requireArea`; the handler applies its own rule.

| Method | Path | Rule in handler |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/access/grants` | caller must be assigned to the product in `scope` |
| `POST` | `/api/access/grants/:grantId/approve` | approver must be Owner or Operations and not the requester (`Backend/auth/jit.ts`) |

### In-handler checks (`can(...)`)

Calls to `can(principal, area, level)` inside handlers, where the outcome
changes what is returned rather than refusing the request.

| Administration | `view` | [Backend/routes/locations.routes.ts:91](../../Backend/routes/locations.routes.ts#L91) |

## How the web app uses the matrix

The UI navigates by page *area*; `Frontend/src/api/capabilities.ts` maps each
one to a server area. A page is shown when the role's level in that server
area is at least `view` **and** the page is in the role's curated list in
`Frontend/src/data/roles.ts`. Denial wins: the curated list can hide a page
the server would allow, never the reverse. A page with no server area
(`—`) is available to every signed-in member.

|---|---|
| `overview` | — |
| `my-work` | — |
| `inbox` | — |
| `messages` | — |
| `sessions` | — |
| `settings` | — |

| `code-security` | Repository |
| `dev-tools` | Repository |
| `deployments` | Deployment |
| `incidents` | Infrastructure |
| `monitors` | Infrastructure |
| `team` | Organization |
| `security` | Administration |
| `audit` | Administration |
| `integrations` | Administration |

## Consistency checks

### Curated actions the server denies

Actions a role's curated list offers but its matrix row does not reach. The UI
hides them (denial wins); they are listed so the curated lists can be
corrected rather than silently disagreeing with the matrix.

| Role | Action | Needs | Role has |
|---|---|---|---|
| Operations | `time:log` | Project ≥ `contribute` | `view` |
| Operations | `doc:create` | Project ≥ `contribute` | `view` |
| Operations | `doc:publish` | Project ≥ `manage` | `view` |

### Authenticated routes without an area guard

These routes require a verified session but no `requireArea`, so every role
can call them. Most scope their rows by product in the handler; the ones that
return organisation-wide data are noted in
[Roles and permissions](roles-and-permissions.md#routes-open-to-every-signed-in-member).

`POST /api/auth/step-up` · `POST /api/auth/passkeys/options` · `POST /api/auth/passkeys` · `DELETE /api/auth/passkeys/:credentialId` · `GET /api/auth/session` · `DELETE /api/auth/sessions/:sessionPrefix` · `POST /api/auth/sign-out-everywhere` · `GET /api/codespaces/oauth/url` · `GET /api/codespaces` · `POST /api/codespaces` · `GET /api/codespaces/:name` · `POST /api/codespaces/:name/<action>` · `GET /api/docs/:docId` · `GET /api/locations/me` · `GET /api/locations/lookup` · `GET /api/locations/regions` · `GET /api/locations/sign-ins` · `GET /api/locations/summary` · `GET /api/locations/sessions` · `POST /api/locations/assess` · `GET /api/incidents` · `GET /api/incidents/_stats` · `GET /api/incidents/:id` · `POST /api/incidents` · `PATCH /api/incidents/:id` · `GET /api/products` · `GET /api/scope` · `GET /api/audit` · `GET /api/audit/verify` · `GET /api/security/posture` · `GET /api/security/rate-limits` · `GET /api/backups` · `GET /api/_inventory` · `GET /api/_config` · `GET /api/_metrics` · `GET /api/_logs` · `GET /api/_events` · `GET /api/_query/collections` · `POST /api/_query` · `GET /api/tasks/:key` · `GET /api/team/roles` · `GET /api/me/capabilities` · `POST /api/access/grants` · `POST /api/access/grants/:grantId/approve`
